text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: It's just a little scratch! You're such a worrywart, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: See, I can still hop around and everything!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: See? I'm fine! Okay?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Stay still? Okay, I gotcha! I won't worry you anymore!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Stay… still… Stay… perfectly… still…

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: …Bwah!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Pant… pant… Staying still is… really hard.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I calm her down by telling her she can at least keep breathing while staying still.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Wh-why are you so angry? It really doesn't hurt, you know.
choice_data_list: I want you in fighting shape to take first place.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Trainer…

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Understood! Okay, I won't hop around anymore!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: No more injuries, no siree! I got no injuries and I got no pai―

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: …H-huh? Actually, my toes are starting to hurt a bit…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Likely due to the jumping, I figure. After I take care of her newly-formed injuries, I make her rest for the day.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I promise! No more injuries! I'll be careful in my races and my studies!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: So, please let me train again!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I'll do a lot of deep stretches, and I can't get hurt from just watching races, right?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I also wanna be ready to get first place, y'know!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Come on, let me show you how careful I can be!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I believe her and allow her to resume her training after treating her injuries.
